applies_when: A fixed script runs under wsl-bwrap.
The input model is readable but a host-only STEP path fails before output creation.

claim: For the two reproduced fixed scripts, /input/model.step restores STEP readability; this does not establish a generic generated-script or helper rule.

counterexamples: abc_v00_00000030: unavailable import fails before STEP reading

runtime_action: Inspect the structured input-readability and execution signals first. If they match this scope, use the sandbox input mount path only as a bounded hypothesis and retain all existing output and geometry gates.

validation.review_trigger: Re-review after any sandbox mount-layout change or a third independently traced path case; do not promote without a separate workpack.
